turns.input: My name is Sam Okafor. Our Organization ID is 480113. I can sign in to Playback, but the church's songs are locked for me. Can you check whether my account has the right access?
turns.reply: Your organization’s subscription is active, but your account doesn’t have Playback Team Sharing permission, which is why the purchased songs stay locked. A church admin can enable that permission for you on the People page at MultiTracks.com.
